items.title: Ray Vega interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 20, 2023
items.q: I was still studying with Lonnie Hillyer, studying with Henry Novak

ctx.x: You want to play stickball instead?

You want to hang out, you want to play, you’ve got your girlfriend. You’re listening to records. You don’t know how to practice. And it wasn’t until I found some really great teachers in the mid-1980s. It really helped me to kind of focus, how to practice and how to work on things. And you know one was a harmony teacher named Susan Winder, another one was Henry Novak who played trumpet with the New York City Ballet, and then for a short period this guy named Lonnie Hillyer who played with Charles Mingus’s band,…
I was going to ask you about that. You were born in 1961 is that correct?
